audience: coaches and team managers who plan rosters, practices and games in TeamSnap

useCases.title: Check the roster of a team
useCases.text: List your teams, then list the members of one team. The list shows names, positions, jersey numbers and manager flags.

useCases.title: Review the events for the coming weeks
useCases.text: List the events of a team with their start date, duration and status. Ask the assistant which games and practices fall in the next 14 days.

useCases.title: Find where a team plays and trains
useCases.text: List the saved locations of a team, such as fields and venues. Match the location id of each event to see where it takes place.

useCases.title: Add a practice to the team calendar
useCases.text: Create a practice or other event for a team. Team members are not notified unless you ask the assistant to notify them.
